en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing an outdoor municipal swimming pool complex. The main left image features a concrete multi‑level diving platform over a large pool with trees and a grassy area in the background. The two images on the right show different perspectives of the same pool, including swimmers, starting blocks numbered 1–4, railings, and low poolside buildings surrounded by tall trees. At the bottom margin, stylized wave symbols flank the printed title "Stadtbad Meißen."
